violated_contract: A macOS app that requests Calendar access under the hardened runtime must carry the Calendar resource entitlement in its signed bundle, not only a Calendar usage-description string in Info.plist. Without it, TCC refuses to display the permission prompt, the app never appears in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Calendars, and EventKit returns unavailable even when the user wants to grant access.
canonical_prevention: Keep the Calendar entitlement in development and release signing inputs and assert that named-bundle fallback generation preserves it. Verify the installed hardened-runtime bundle's effective entitlement during pilot smoke testing before interpreting an absent Calendar prompt as a user denial.
